fact: The GPE completion report for the PREAT, filed on 4 July 2025, states that decentralisation of the ministry's SIGE was tested in 40 schools of N'Djamena, each given a desktop computer and a solar kit handed over on 28 December 2022 and its director basic computer training for collecting data at the school, under a GPE grant of 50 million US dollars managed by UNICEF; it describes the SIGE as StatEduc entry producing statistical yearbooks and names no record per learner.
title: Rapport d'achèvement du financement ESPIG — Chad_ESPIG_05/22/2018 (PREAT)
why_not: A trial of school-level collection for the census; the report names no record per learner (parent, 2026-10-09).
